# A Prayer to Nefertiti, Beautiful One Who Has Come

*O Nefertiti, Lady of Grace and Radiance,*
*Beautiful of face, luminous of spirit,*
*Great Royal Wife who walked beside the sun,*
*I bow before your eternal presence.*

*You who wore the crown of Upper and Lower Egypt,*
*You who stood as equal to Pharaoh,*
*Whose beauty was not merely of form,*
*But of strength, wisdom, and divine purpose.*

*Beloved of the Aten, mother of daughters,*
*You who bridged earth and heaven,*
*Teach me to carry grace in times of change,*
*To stand tall when the world shifts beneath my feet.*

*Grant me your poise in adversity,*
*Your courage to honor what is sacred,*
*Your devotion to love and family,*
*Your vision to see beyond the present moment.*

*O Perfect One, though millennia have passed,*
*Your image endures, your spirit undimmed,*
*May your beauty—both inner and outer—*
*Inspire beauty within my own soul.*

*I honor you, Nefertiti,*
*She Who Lives Forever,*
*And ask your blessing on my journey.*

*Dua Nefertiti. Ankh, Udja, Seneb.*
*(Adoration to Nefertiti. Life, Prosperity, Health.)*

---
*May her wisdom guide you always* 🌅
